equivalent-group-dedup-and-unless-confli.rules.yaml:
groups:
- name: safe-metadata-join
  interval: 1m
  rules:
  - record: instance_version:build_info
    expr: group by(instance,version) (build_info == 1)
  - record: instance:inflight_with_version
    expr: http_inflight_requests * on(instance) group_left(version) (instance_version:build_info
      unless on(instance) (count by(instance) (instance_version:build_info) != 1))
  - alert: MetadataVersionConflict
    expr: count by(instance) (instance_version:build_info) > 1
    for: 0m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: More than one version for instance
  - alert: MetadataUnavailable
    expr: http_inflight_requests unless on(instance) instance_version:build_info
    for: 0m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: No valid build metadata for active instance
